newsitem.title: INDIA: Two Mexicans kidnapped in northern India - agency.
newsitem.headline: Two Mexicans kidnapped in northern India - agency.

text.p: Two Mexican engineers were kidnapped in India's northern state of Punjab, the United News of India (UNI) said on Monday.
The news agency reported the two engineers named Eduardo Moral and Sergo Orlix Sanchez were on an assignment at a brewery in the border state's Jalandhar district.
The engineers were returning from the factory to their hotel in Ludhiana city when they were kidnapped on Saturday, the UNI said.
"I do not have any news about these people," a spokesman at the Mexican embassy in New Delhi told Reuters by telephone.
At least 20,000 people were killed during a Sikh revolt in the 1980s which rocked Punjab. The violence died down after local elections in 1992.
